input.name: Read member savings balance
input.description: Signs on to the CoreVue 7.2 back-office console, looks up a member by member number via Member Lookup, and returns the current balance of their Savings (S1) share account along with the member name shown on the Member Detail screen. Read-only: no records are modified. Note: the behaviour for a non-existent member number was deliberately not exercised during recording (probing it would have polluted the replayable flow), so no MEMBER_NOT_FOUND outcome text is declared yet.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the CoreVue console.

inputs.name: memberNumber
inputs.description: The credit union member number to look up.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's Savings (S1) share account, without currency symbol (e.g. 4,182.55).

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Member name as shown on the Member Detail screen, in LAST, FIRST M format.
